name: FactCheck-Bench
why_it_matters: Newsrooms increasingly use AI to vet statistics and quotes, so benchmarks measuring whether models can verify specific claims against authoritative evidence are directly relevant to editorial fact-checking workflows.
task_shape: Given an LLM-generated response, models must identify check-worthy claims, decompose them into atomic facts, retrieve supporting evidence from the web, and label each claim as supported, contradicted, or unverifiable.
signals: Fine-grained 10-step annotated pipeline lets evaluators pinpoint where verification breaks down (claim detection, retrieval, or judgment).
Relies on open web retrieval rather than authoritative government databases, so it approximates but does not isolate source-authority verification.
